_comment: Ratchet config for scripts/codecharta-ratchet.py (not yet added — see codecharta.yml, which treats the ratchet gate as non-blocking until that script lands), run against the CodeCharta map (hostus.cc.json.gz). Seeded permissive/empty on the SP0 skeleton; ratchet down (tighten caps, add baselines) as the ratchet script and real code land.

complexity._default_cap_note: Per-file SUM of function complexity. Every file not listed below must stay <= this.

function_complexity._default_cap_note: The single most complex FUNCTION in a file (McCabe). New functions must stay <= this; tighten as the codebase grows.

hotspot._note: A file is a hotspot when it is complex AND under-tested; new hotspots fail the build.
